item.title: Artificial Intelligence and Social Media in B2B Markets: Transforming Relationships, Capabilities, and Value Creation
item.content:encoded:
This special issue in Industrial Marketing Management explores how artificial intelligence and social media are reshaping B2B marketing landscapes. The focus is on understanding the transformative impact of these technologies on business relationships, organizational capabilities, and the mechanisms through which value is created in B2B contexts.

Appel publié par Industrial Marketing Management. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
